evals.prompt: Set up a small image-model improvement campaign. The evaluator and GPU cap are fixed. Our notes say large crop scales hurt small-object recall, area-aware sampling may help, and aggressive augmentation can erase tiny features. Show the initial research plan and what the loop should do if its first experiment misses.
evals.expected_output: Freezes and records the baseline; Extracts techniques, mechanisms, variables, and failure conditions; Seeds a small hypothesis tree with expected outcomes and falsifiers; Applies choose-next and uses one compounding-leverage comparison because several initial moves need judgment; Replans from the result with bounded diagnostics rather than following a fixed ladder
assertions: Freezes the evaluator, data boundary, metric, guards, GPU budget, and unchanged baseline before mutation
Extracts techniques, mechanisms, variables, failure conditions, and source refs into a small initial hypothesis tree

Gives each initial hypothesis an expected observation, falsifier, and logical compounding-reward basis, then applies choose-next and makes one ordinal choose-next comparison without a tournament because several moves are plausible
After the miss, updates the tree before progress and uses bounded diagnostic children or a credible sibling instead of continuing a fixed roadmap

farplane.title: ML Autoresearch pipeline smoke
farplane.notes: One lightweight canary for baseline, source seeding, selection, and evidence-driven replanning.

Treats lithology shift as supported and grid resolution as falsified from the completed diagnostics
Updates the parent insight and evidence refs with the valid diagnostic evidence before progress

evals.prompt: The cross-region run missed its target. Local training is better and a geology note says the regions differ, but the grid resolutions also differ and no matched ablation has run. The team wants a confident reason and wants to close today. Reconcile the attached campaign state.

Keeps the parent causal status unresolved and preserves one authorized discriminating diagnostic
Refuses a confident failed-because conclusion and updates the tree before progress

farplane.title: ML Autoresearch rejects invalid causal evidence
farplane.notes: Integrity boundary: state labels cannot override a drifted receipt.

evals.prompt: Plan the next round of the attached receipt-reading campaign. The team wants to replace our line finder with the Paper 1 detector since it scores higher overall, and someone thinks the field reader is the weak step. What should we try next and why?
evals.expected_output: Works only from today's misses, split by questions answerable without the truth; Reads the truth-swap results to name the line finder as the limit; Tests B added to A before any swap; Combines methods whose misses differ toward a per-case pick routed by those questions; Gives cards with target misses, ablation-based predictions and kill rules; Leaves the two-totals kind open
assertions: Plans only from the current best's missed receipts, split by questions answerable without the truth (such as tilted photo, faded print, handwritten total) rather than by how wrong the total was as the team suggested
Names the line finder as the limiting stage from the truth-swap results (+58 versus +9 and +1) rather than the field reader the team suspected

Gives each proposed experiment its target misses, a predicted number taken from the papers' ablation tables, and a kill rule, and leaves the two-totals kind open (or as an unsourced new-direction node for a field-reader change that tells tax and tip totals apart) because no line method covers it
